name: llmproxy
description: Standalone GitHub Copilot proxy CLI with native service management

0.2.60: embed current release notes in the installed package for first-update compatibility
keep deriving update changelogs from the release commit message when available
preserve hardcoded release notes only as a backward-compatible final fallback
0.2.61: stabilize launchd service restart by avoiding explicit stop before kickstart on macOS
treat missing launchd bootout targets as already stopped during service recovery
cap forwarded Copilot tools to 128 on both /responses and /chat/completions
make claude:setup and model:set target the installed llmproxy service port when LLMPROXY_HOME is set
0.2.62: add explicit vision capability for providers with --vision flag in provider:add and provider:key
implement automatic fallback skip for non-vision providers when requests contain images
add provider:test command to verify vision capability of all configured providers
add reasoning_content support for Kimi and other thinking models
add qwen3.7-plus, deepseek-v4-pro, kimi-k2.6 to model-capabilities registry
0.2.63: support multiple instances of the same provider with different models via provider:add
fix update-service.sh: use docker-compose.production.yml and set LLMPROXY_HOME when missing
fix update-service.sh: graceful skip when Docker Compose is not installed
0.2.65: fix llmproxy test: accept metadata-only provider responses when request_summary confirms success
stabilize provider test fallback handling for delayed request_summary writes
0.2.66: fix self-update: resolve the installed CLI even when the global wrapper path is stale or missing
recreate the global llmproxy entrypoint after update so the shell command remains available immediately
ensure self-update preserves the currently hashed llmproxy path by rewriting it with sudo when necessary
0.2.68: fix self-update: always prefer the freshly installed package CLI over stale wrappers discovered in PATH
recreate the global llmproxy wrapper automatically when it is missing after update
protect the valid global wrapper from cleanup so llmproxy update cannot remove its own entrypoint
0.2.69: document in CLAUDE.md that every commit and push must include an llmproxy version bump first
0.2.70: fix self-update: recreate legacy wrappers such as /usr/bin/llmproxy after update
preserve standard wrapper paths during update cleanup to avoid removing the active command
0.2.71: fix self-update with nvm: preserve the caller's original npm global bin path before switching Node versions
recreate llmproxy in the original npm prefix so the command remains available in the user's active shell
0.2.72: feat: auto-escalation to better providers on repeated requests
add EscalationTracker — detects when the same user message is resent N times
automatically escalates to the next provider after threshold identical messages (LLMPROXY_AUTO_ESCALATE=1)
0.2.73: fix self-update: make generated wrappers point directly to the installed package CLI instead of another global wrapper
fix nvm update path so llmproxy remains callable after upgrading from an older user-global install
0.2.74: test: add 12 unit tests for EscalationTracker auto-escalation module
cover disabled/enabled modes, threshold escalation, multi-level, conversation isolation, cleanup, and eviction
